# MakeMyStay.ai

MakeMyStay.ai is an AI-powered real estate and rental platform for verified PGs, coliving spaces, and rental flats in Bangalore.

## Important Pages

- https://makemystay.ai/
- https://makemystay.ai/pg/bangalore
- https://makemystay.ai/rent/bangalore
- https://makemystay.ai/research
- https://makemystay.ai/reports
- https://makemystay.ai/statistics
- https://makemystay.ai/how-we-verify
- https://makemystay.ai/blog
- https://makemystay.ai/contact-us

## Research And Citation Pages

- https://makemystay.ai/reports - Bangalore PG Rent Index and monthly rental market reports.
- https://makemystay.ai/research - Bangalore PG and coliving research hub.
- https://makemystay.ai/statistics - Structured PG rent statistics by locality.
